A '''flash canister''' was a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] used by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces during the [[New Sith Wars]]. They could temporarily blind opponents. Notably, they were used during the [[Battle of Phaseera]] in [[1002 BBY]].
